state:
**Goal `ext-image`: Stages 2 to 5 are done on disk, and Stage 6 (the feature proofs) is in progress.** ADR 0120, ADR 0247 and the goal file's § *Standing decisions* settle the design, and no session re-decides it.

The component is embedded and callable with no `nvs.toml` (`crates/nvs-cli/src/extensions.rs` module doc). The `Novis\Image` builder is Novis source in `extensions/image/nvs/`, and `rule:core-classes/image-pipeline`'s fragment says what it has and lacks. Stage 5's figure is in `benches/results/image-guest.json` and `rule:packaging/the-boundary-is-the-cost`.

Stage 6, on disk: `nvs meta --json` lists the built-in classes and enums (`crates/nvs-cli/src/meta.rs` module doc). The proofs roster gives a `Novis\` member the path `novis/<tail>/<member>` (`memberPath` in `tools/nv/proofs/roster.ts`; `tools/nv/test/roster-novis.test.ts`), and an enum keeps `types/Novis-Image-Fit`. `bun nv reference` reads a `Novis\` class's intro from `docs/reference/novis/<tail>.md` (`docs/reference/README.md`), and `docs/reference/novis/Image-Image.md` is written.

Still red, all Stage 6: the `Novis\Image` proofs (`dossier-novis-image-pipeline`, `dossier-novis-image-carries-plain-comments`).

items.text: **The proofs for the `Novis\Image\Image` source members** (`open`, `create`, `fromRaw`, `info`, `resize`, `crop`, … `variants`, `raw`): `about.md`, three examples with `.out`, one attack, one bench each, per `rule:testing/feature-proofs`; `bun nv proofs --id 'Novis\Image\Image::resize'` prints the paths. Comments follow AGENTS.md § *Text an end user reads*, checked with `bun nv proofs --comments`. A 3x2 PNG as hex is in `tests/conformance/novis/image-a-pipeline-is-a-value-and-runs-at-its-terminal.nvst`. Anchor: `extensions/image/nvs/Image.nvs:8`.
**`Novis\Image\Color::rgba` and `::hex`, and the six enums**: the enums owe `about.md` and examples only. Anchor: `extensions/image/nvs/Color.nvs:8`.

**`Novis\Image\Codec`'s members**: examples and bench are `skip` entries in `data/proofs/policy.json` with the reason as the value (goal file § *Stage 6*). `Codec` has no class card, so its members show a help gap in the roster; either the manifest gains a class `help` field (`crates/nvs-ext/src/manifest.rs`) or the help proof is a skip with its reason. Anchor: `crates/nvs-cli/src/meta.rs:617`.

backlog: A manifest enum's card has a `short` only; per-case lines (`rule:core-api/reference-card`) need a manifest field for them (`crates/nvs-ext/src/manifest.rs`).
`docs/novis.md` files the `Novis\` classes under Part B, "The `Core` library", with `core-` anchors (`tools/nv/cmd/reference.ts` `renderClass`); a Part of their own is a later polish.
